preconditions.description: The length of the string S is between 2 and 10^5.
All characters in the string S are lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: return_value == len(set(S[i] + S[j] for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i+1, len(S))))
postconditions.description: The function returns the number of distinct strings obtainable by swapping any two distinct indices i and j in the string S.
